overview: When the bell stopped you wrote one line on the tables. A duke to be married, four days, the old moon. The line is the Knight's Tale. You did not hang a play on it.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Entered the line from the tale and left it there.

assets.disposition: Wrote one line of the Knight's Tale
